questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 2, 4, 8, 16, ___
questions.explanation: Each number is doubled to get the next: 16 x 2 = 32.

questions.q: Book is to Pages as Wall is to ___
questions.explanation: A book is made up of pages, just as a wall is made up of bricks.
Apple, mango and banana are fruits, while carrot is a vegetable.

questions.q: Find the next letter in the series: A, C, F, J, ___
questions.explanation: The gaps increase by one each time (+2, +3, +4), so J + 5 = O.

questions.q: If 5 workers can build a wall in 12 days, how long will 6 workers take?
If CAT is coded as 24 (3 + 1 + 20), what is DOG coded as?
Doctor is to Hospital as Teacher is to ___
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital, just as a teacher works in a school.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ___
questions.explanation: The gaps increase by 2 each time (+3, +5, +7, +9), so 27 + 11 = 38.
121, 144 and 169 are perfect squares (11^2, 12^2, 13^2); 190 is not.

questions.q: All managers are employees. Ahmed is a manager. What follows?
questions.explanation: Since Ahmed belongs to the group 'managers' and all managers are employees, Ahmed must be an employee.
